The '''''Terminus''-class destroyer''' was a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in use by the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Description==
The ''Terminus''-class was similar in appearance to the smaller [[Gage-class transport|''Gage''-class transport]], but wielded far more firepower.<ref name="TORC" /> Despite the similar features found onboard the two ships, the ''Terminus'' destroyer was built as a dedicated warship used for a number of tasks such as escort missions, search and destroy or transporting important Imperial figures. This ship class boasted an impressive array of weaponry making it a match for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvettes]] and [[Hammerhead-class cruiser]]s that were used as the workhorses of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. Despite its ability to deal heavy damage to ships of its size, it was incapable of taking on the Republic's [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruisers]]. These ships were also used for securing recently captured territories in order to not tie up [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts]].

For the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]], the standard ''Terminus'' destroyer was commonly seen in skirmishes and battles across the galaxy. However, the ships were modifiable; Darth Marr used a Terminus-class cruiser as his flagship, which was outfitted with additional turbolaser batteries on top of the standard model.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire" /> Another, more notable example of this was the ''[[Ascendant Spear]]'', which was modeled on the Terminus-class's frame, but more than a mile long and boasted far more firepower, a faster hyperdrive, and a specialized command-and-control sphere that integrated the ship's controls into the mind of a cybernetically enhanced Force user.<ref name="The Old Republic: Annihilation">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''</ref> During the [[third Galactic War]], a version of the ship retrofitted with reactors and engines that utilized [[Isotope-5]] was used in the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex]].<ref name="Objective Meridian">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Objective Meridian}}</ref>

==History==
A pair of these vessels were used as patrol ships of the [[Vesla system/Legends|Vesla system]] in the years after the [[Great Galactic War]]. [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] agent [[Theron Shan]] managed to avoid the two destroyers during his infiltration of the [[Black sector|Black Sector]].<ref name="TOR" />

[[File:Darth_Marrs_flagship_and_the_Eternal_Fleet.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Darth Marr's flagship]] was destroyed by the [[Eternal Fleet]].]]
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], ''Terminus''-class destroyers often supported other capital ships during military operations. As well a number of them were used to protect [[Vaiken Spacedock]] from enemy attacks in combination with ''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

This class would be used greatly during the renewed conflict between the Sith Empire and the Republic known as the [[Galactic War]] where they were deployed in combat missions with the iconic ''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts against the Republic Forces. [[Darth Marr]] made use of a modified [[Darth Marr's flagship|flagship]] of this class until it was destroyed by the [[Eternal Fleet]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' - "Chapter 1: The Hunt"</ref> Several more ships would appear at the [[Invasion of Voss]] and the [[War on Iokath|Battle of Iokath]], under the orders of [[Darth Acina|Empress Acina]]. Several were also used by the [[Eternal Alliance]] in their [[war against Zakuul]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''</ref>

The ship was still in use during the [[third Galactic War]], and was present at the [[Invasion of Ossus]]. One was present at a deep space skirmish that occurred in the buildup to the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex]], and 73 Terminus-class destroyers were present in that invasion fleet itself.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''</ref>
